## Precision Maintenance & Shaft Alignment

An engineering knowledge series focused on
mechanical preparation, precision measurement,
controlled adjustment, and technical verification
of rotating machinery.

### Technical Development Portfolio

| Reference | Technical Subject | Development Status |
|---|---|---|
| ECS-001 | Precision Shaft Alignment | In development |

These publications are being developed from
professional learning, engineering analysis,
and practical maintenance experience.

Public versions will use independently reviewed

They are not substitutes for OEM instructions,
site-approved procedures, or applicable
safety requirements.


### SOP-001 — Motor Soft Foot Detection & Correction

An applied engineering methodology covering
mechanical preparation, soft foot identification,
measurement techniques, shim selection, and
verification practices.
